entries.title: tabernacles
entries.content:
tabernacles = tents, or dwellings. Hebrew. 'ohel . App-40 (3).

The right hand. Figure of speech Anthropopatheia. App-6 .

doeth valiantly. Figure of speech Coenotes ( App-6 ), repeated in Psalms 118:16 .

entries.title: works.
entries.content: works. Some codices, with one early printed edition, read "work" (singular)

entries.title: The stone:
entries.content:
The stone: i.e. the Messiah. See Genesis 49:24 . A stone of stumbling, Isaiah 8:14 (compare Romans 9:33 . 1 Peter 2:8 ); a "tried stone", "precious", "sure", Isaiah 28:16 ; the rejected stone (compare Matthew 21:42 .Mark 12:10 , Mark 12:11 .Luke 20:17 . Acts 4:11 . 1 Peter 2:4 ). The true foundation, Isaiah 28:16 (compare Matthew 16:18 . 1 Corinthians 3:11 .Ephesians 2:20; Ephesians 2:20 ).

refused. See note above, and compare Structure, 22-24 with 26-28, above. Here the present Dispensation comes in. See App-72 .

entries.title: This is the LORD'S doing.
entries.content: This is the LORD'S doing. Messiah's exaltation is thus like the humiliation (Psalms 109:27 ).

entries.title: Save now, &c.
entries.content: Save now, &c. Hebrew "Hosanna" = Save, I pray. Not a Particle of time , but of entreaty (as in Ecclesiastes 12:1 ). Repeated four times for emphasis. Literally "I pray Thee, Jehovah; Save; I pray Thee; I pray Thee, O Jehovah".

entries.title: Blessed, &c.
entries.content:
Blessed, &c. See Matthew 21:9 ; Matthew 23:39 . Mark 11:9 . Luke 13:35 ; Luke 19:38 . John 12:13 .

you. Plural.

entries.title: GOD.
entries.content:
GOD. Hebrew El. App-4 .

Bind. Hebrew. 'asar, to bind, or join. Here, in its idiomatic usage, to join, so as to make ready (Genesis 46:29 . Exo 14:6 . 1 Kings 18:44 . 2 Kings 9:21 ), or begin (1 Kings 20:14 . 2 Chronicles 13:3 ).

sacrifice. Hebrew. hag = a feast, or festal [sacrifice]. See note on Exodus 23:18 , and compare Exodus 5:1 ; Exodus 12:14 ; Exodus 23:14 .Leviticus 23:39 , Leviticus 23:41 .Numbers 29:12 .Deuteronomy 16:15 .Zechariah 14:16 , Zechariah 14:18 , Zechariah 14:19 .

cords = wreaths, or garlands, as in Exodus 28:14 , Exodus 28:22 , Exodus 28:24 , Exodus 28:25 ; Exodus 39:15 , Exodus 39:17 , Exodus 39:18 .

even unto. Hebrew. 'ad = up to or during: i.e. even until [it is consummated at] the horns of the altar. 'Ad denotes progression in time. Translate: "Make ready the festal sacrifice with garlands until [it is consummated at] the horns of the altar. "Compare Acts 14:13 . There is nothing about "to the altar" here.

entries.title: praise
entries.content:
praise = give thanks.

God. Hebrew. Elohim. App-4 .

entries.title: Blessed
entries.content:
Probably by Hezekiah. See App-67 , Psalms 123:3 , and notes below. An Acrostic Psalm ( App-63 ), in which each verse in each of the twenty-two sections commences with the twenty-two successive letters of the Hebrew alphabet: i.e. the first eight begin with Aleph (= A), the second eight with Beth (= B), &c.: making 176 verses in all (i.e. 8 x 22). For the ten words (corresponding with the Ten Commandments) which are characteristic of this Psalm, see App-73 .

Blessed = How happy (see App-63 .). Here plural = O the great happiness.

way. The first of the ten words. See App-73 . The thirteen occurrences of this word in this Psalm are all noted below, as are those of the other nine.

law. The sixth in order of the ten words. See App-73 .

the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 .

entries.title: Blessed.
entries.content:
Blessed. This Psalm, begins with a double Beatitude. See App-63 .

keep = guard.

testimonies. The second in order of the ten words. See App-73 .

entries.title: iniquity
entries.content: iniquity = perversity. Hebrew. 'aval . App-44 .

entries.title: precepts.
entries.content: precepts. The third in order of the ten words. See App-73 .

entries.title: statutes.
entries.content: statutes. The ninth in order of the ten words. See App-73 .

entries.title: ashamed
entries.content:
ashamed = put to shame; not shame of conscience.

commandments. The tenth in order of the ten words. See App-73 .

entries.title: praise
entries.content:
praise = give thanks, as in Psalms 92:1 , &c.

righteous = righteousness: i.e. judgments of Thy righteousness. The eighth in order of the ten words. See App-73 .

judgments. The seventh in order of the ten words. See App-73 .

entries.title: not utterly
entries.content: not utterly = not in any wise. Compare Psalms 119:43 .

entries.title: a young man.
entries.content:
a young man. The writer not necessarily a youth.

way = path. Not the same word as in Psalms 119:1 .

By taking = So as to take. Put interrogation at end of the second line instead of the first.

word = the articulate subject-matter of what is said. The tenth in order of the ten words of this Psalm. See note on Psalms 18:30 . App-73 . Not the same word as in Psalms 119:11 . Some codices, with Aramaean, Septuagint, Syriac, and Vulgate, read "words" (plural)

entries.title: word
entries.content:
word = the mode, or purport of what is said. The fifth in order of the ten words of this Psalm. See App-73 . Some codices, with one early printed edition, Aramaean, Septuagint, Syriac, and Vulgate, read "words" (plural)

hid = treasured up.

sin. Hebrew. chata' . App-44 .

entries.title: lips . . . declared.
entries.content: lips . . . declared. Figure of speech Paronomasia. App-6 : bispatay sipparti.

entries.title: word.
entries.content: word. Same word as in Psalms 119:9 (not Psalms 119:11 ): but some codices, with two early printed editions, Aramaean, Septuagint, Syriac, and Vulgate, read "words" (plural)

entries.title: Open
entries.content: Open = Unveil. behold = discern, or see clearly.

entries.title: stranger
entries.content: stranger = foreigner sojourning.

entries.title: soul.
entries.content:
soul. Hebrew. nephesh. App-13 .

breaketh for = hath broken owing to. Occurring again only in Lamentations 3:16 .

longing = fervent desire; same word as verses: Psalms 119:40 , Psalms 119:174 , but not Psalms 119:131 .

entries.title: err
entries.content: err = go far astray (through wine or passion). Same word as "wander" (Psalms 119:10 ), and "err" (Psalms 119:118 ). Hebrew. shagah App-44 .

entries.title: reproach and contempt.
entries.content: reproach and contempt. Compare Psalms 123:3 , Psalms 123:4 , confirming Hezekiah's suggested authorship.

entries.title: also
entries.content:
also = nevertheless. See Psalms 129:2 .

my counsellors = men (Hebrew. 'ish, App-14 ) of my counsel.

entries.title: dust.
entries.content:
dust. Put by Figure of speech Metonymy (of Adjunct), App-6 , for the dead, as in Psalms 30:9 . Ecclesiastes 12:7 .

Quicken . . . me = Give me life, or keep me alive. The first of nine prayers for quickening (Imperative), verses: Psalms 119:37 , Psalms 119:40 , Psalms 119:88 , Psalms 119:107 , Psalms 119:149 , Psalms 119:154 , Psalms 119:156 , Psalms 119:159 . Twice as a statement of fact, verses: Psalms 119:50 , Psalms 119:93 .

word . As in Psalms 119:9 ; but some codices read ' words" (plural)

entries.title: talk
entries.content: talk = meditate.

entries.title: melteth
entries.content:
melteth = weepeth. Occurs only here. Job 16:20 . Ecclesiastes 10:18 .

word. As in Psalms 119:9 . Some codices read plural; but other codices, with Septuagint and Vulgate, read "by (or in) thy words" (plural)

entries.title: laid
entries.content: laid = set.

entries.title: stuck
entries.content: stuck = cleaved, or adhered.

entries.title: enlarge my heart
entries.content: enlarge my heart = set my heart at liberty, as in Isa 60:5 . 2 Corinthians 6:11 , 2 Corinthians 6:13 .

entries.title: Teach me
entries.content: Teach me = Show, or make me to see.

entries.title: way.
entries.content: way. Some codices, with three early printed editions, Aramaean, and Syriac, read "ways" (plural)

entries.title: Who is devoted to Thy fear.
entries.content: Who is devoted to Thy fear. Supply Ellipsis thus: "Which [leadeth to] reverence of Thee"; or, "Which [pertaineth to]", &c.

entries.title: fear
entries.content: fear = dread.

entries.title: in:
entries.content:
in: or by.

righteousness. Hebrew. zedakah. See App-73 .

entries.title: mercies
entries.content: mercies = lovingkindnesses.

entries.title: wherewith
entries.content:
wherewith = a word. Hebrew. dabar as in Psalms 119:9 . See App-73 .

reproacheth. See note on "contempt", Psalms 123:3 .

trust in = confide in. Hebrew. batah. App-69 .

word. Some codices, with one early printed edition, Aramaean, Septuagint, and Syriac, read "words" (plural)

entries.title: For ever and ever.
entries.content: For ever and ever. Put by Figure of speech Synecdoche (of Whole), App-6 , for a part: i.e. the rest of his life.

entries.title: at liberty
entries.content: at liberty = at large. Compare Psalms 118:5 .

entries.title: kings.
entries.content: kings. So Hezekiah testified, doubtless, when kings sent presents and embassies to him (2 Chronicles 32:22 , 2 Chronicles 32:23 ). No occasion to suggest a later date for this Psalm.

entries.title: have loved
entries.content: have loved = love. Septuagint adds "much".

entries.title: My hands, &c.
entries.content: My hands, &c. Hebrew idiom = to swear by, as in Genesis 14:22 .Exodus 6:8 (margin) Deuteronomy 32:40 . Ezekiel 20:5 , Ezekiel 20:6 ; Ezekiel 36:7 . See note on Exodus 17:16 .

entries.title: Upon which.
entries.content:
Upon which. This is supported by the Septuagint and Vulgate. In Deuteronomy 29:25 it is rendered "Because".

caused me to hope. Our hope is based on believing what we have "heard" from God. Compare Hebrews 11:1 with Romans 10:17 .

entries.title: comfort.
entries.content:
comfort. The word occurs (as a noun) elsewhere only in Job 6:10 .

quickened me = kept me alive. See note on Psalms 119:25 .

proud = insolent (like Rabshakeh).

entries.title: Horror
entries.content:
Horror = Indignation.

wicked = lawless. Hebrew. rasha'.

entries.title: songs.
entries.content: songs. Put by Figure of speech Metonymy (of Subject), App-6 , for the theme of my songs.

entries.title: name.
entries.content: name. See note on Psalms 20:1 .

entries.title: This.
entries.content: This. Supply Ellipsis ( App-6 ) thus: "This [comfort] I had".
The division is better made thus, dispensing with the supposed Ellipsis: I have said "Jehovah is my portion, That I might keep Thy word. "

entries.title: favour.
entries.content:
favour. Hebrew face; put by Figure of speech Metonymy (of Adjunct), App-6 , for what is indicated by it.

merciful = gracious.

entries.title: robbed
entries.content: robbed = surrounded. Compare Sennacherib's investment of Hezekiah. See App-67 .

entries.title: companion
entries.content:
companion = fellow of the same party.

fear = revere.

entries.title: mercy
entries.content: mercy = lovingkindness, or grace.

entries.title: Before.
entries.content:
Before. If we begin this verse with the word "Till", and Psalms 119:71 with '"Tis", then each verse in this section will commence with "T", as it does in the Hebrew.

afflicted = oppressed.

But now. Compare Hebrews 12:6-11 , and references there.

entries.title: good
entries.content: good = kind. doest good = actest kindly.

entries.title: It is.
entries.content:
It is. See note on Psalms 119:67 .

good = right, or fitting.

entries.title: gold and silver.
entries.content:
gold and silver. Put by Figure of speech Metonymy (of Cause), App-6 , for coins made from these metals.

Jod. This is the small letter referred to in Matthew 5:18 .

entries.title: fashioned
entries.content: fashioned = formed. Compare Job 31:15 ; also Deuteronomy 32:18 .

entries.title: fear
entries.content: fear = revere.

entries.title: right
entries.content:
right = righteousness, as in Psalms 119:7 .

afflicted = humbled.

entries.title: merciful kindness
entries.content: merciful kindness = lovingkindness, or grace.

entries.title: tender mercies
entries.content:
tender mercies = compassions.

For, &c. This is the ground of his prayer.

delight. Plural as in Psalms 119:92 = great delight.

entries.title: proud
entries.content:
proud = insolent, or arrogant.

perversely = with falsehood.

without a cause. Compare John 15:25 with Romans 3:24 ("freely").

entries.title: those that have known.
entries.content: those that have known. Some codices read "and they shall know".

entries.title: sound
entries.content: sound = thorough.

entries.title: fail.
entries.content: fail. Same word as "fainteth", in Psalms 119:81 .

entries.title: bottle
entries.content: bottle = wine-skin: i.e. black and shrivelled. Compare Job 30:30 .

entries.title: many:
entries.content:
many: i.e. few at the most. Compare Psalms 89:47 . 2 Samuel 19:34 .

execute judgment = vindicate.

entries.title: Which, &c.
entries.content:
Which, &c. = "[Men] who are not", &c.

after = according to.

entries.title: faithful
entries.content:
faithful = faithfulness.

wrongfully. See note on "perversely", Psalms 119:78 .

entries.title: almost
entries.content:
almost = soon. See note on "almost" (Proverbs 5:14 ).

consumed = made an end of.

entries.title: For ever, O LORD.
entries.content:
For ever, O LORD. Supply Ellipsis ( App-6 ), "For ever [art Thou], O Jehovah [For ever] Thy Word", &c.

settled = standeth fast, as the earth: i.e. endureth for ever (Psalms 102:12 , Psalms 102:26 . Isaiah 40:8 . Luke 16:17 . 1 Peter 1:25 ). So Christ, the Living Word (John 12:34 ).

entries.title: abideth
entries.content: abideth = standeth, as in Psalms 119:91 .

entries.title: They:
entries.content:
They: i.e. heaven and earth.

continue = stand, as in Psalms 119:90 .

this day = [to] this day, or to-day.

ordinances = regulations. Hebrew. mishpat. The seventh of the ten words. App-73 . Compare Psalms 119:132 .

all. With Art. = the whole [universe].

entries.title: sought
entries.content: sought = inquired into, or studied. Compare Psalms 105:4 .

entries.title: all perfection
entries.content:
all perfection = an end, or limit to all things. Compare Job 26:10 ; Job 28:3 .

Thy commandment, &c. = spacious exceedingly [are] Thy commandments: i.e. including all (as opposed to "end").

they are = it [is]: i.e. the Law containing the commandments.

entries.title: than all my teachers.
entries.content: than all my teachers. Because Divinely taught Divine wisdom.

entries.title: ancients
entries.content: ancients = elders, or the aged ones.

entries.title: evil.
entries.content:
evil. Hebrew. ra'a'. App-44 .

way. Including religious way, in the sense of Acts 9:2 ; Acts 19:9 , Acts 19:23 ; Acts 24:14 . Compare Acts 16:17 ; Acts 18:26 ; especially in Psalms 119:104 .

word. Same word as in Psalms 119:9 . Some codices, with one early printed edition, with Aramaean, Septuagint, Syriac, and Vulgate, read "words" (plural)

entries.title: departed
entries.content:
departed = swerved.

taught = directed.

entries.title: sweet
entries.content: sweet = smooth, or agreeable. Not the same word as in Psalms 19:10 .

entries.title: lamp:
entries.content: lamp: or lantern, for light on the path for the feet; not merely a light for the eyes (Psalms 19:8 ).

entries.title: I will perform it.
entries.content: I will perform it. Some codices, with seven early printed editions, Aramaean, Septuagint, Syriac, and Vulgate, read "I have performed it"; but some codices, with four early printed editions (1 in margin), read "and will perform it".

entries.title: in my hand.
entries.content: in my hand. An idiom for great danger. Compare Judges 12:3 . 1Sa 19:5 ; 1 Samuel 28:21 .Job 13:14 .

entries.title: erred
entries.content: erred = to err from the paths of virtue and piety. Hebrew. ta'ah ; not the same word as in verses: Psalms 119:21 , Psalms 119:118 .

entries.title: thoughts
entries.content: thoughts = divided or doubting thoughts. Same root as 1 Kings 18:21 (compare James 1:8 ); or, them that are of double mind.

entries.title: hiding place.
entries.content: hiding place. Compare Psalms 32:7 ; Psalms 91:1 . shield. Compare Psalms 84:9 , and note. Figure of speech Anthropopatheia. App-6 .

entries.title: God.
entries.content: God. Hebrew. Elohim. App-4 . But "my God" implies Jehovah.

entries.title: live.
entries.content: live. See note || on p. 827.

entries.title: and I shall be safe
entries.content:
and I shall be safe = so shall I be saved.

have respect unto. Aram, and Syriac read "find dear delight in". Septuagint reads "shall meditate".

entries.title: trodden down:
entries.content: trodden down: or set at naught.

entries.title: Thou puttest away.
entries.content: Thou puttest away. Septuagint and Vulg, read "I have accounted".

entries.title: My flesh trembleth:
entries.content: My flesh trembleth: or, My flesh creeps (as we say). Compare Job 4:15 , i.e. at the judgment executed on the wicked.

entries.title: justice
entries.content: justice = righteousness. Same word as in Psalms 119:7 .

entries.title: proud
entries.content: proud = arrogant. This is the only verse in this Psalm which has not one of the "ten words", unless we may include the Living Word Himself, Who is the "surety" for His people. See note on Proverbs 11:15 , and compare Hebrews 7:22 . See App-73 .

entries.title: mercy
entries.content: mercy = lovingkindness, or grace.

entries.title: to work:
entries.content: to work: i.e. to intervene.

entries.title: wonderful.
entries.content:
wonderful. Same root as in verses: Psalms 119:18 , Psalms 119:27 .

keep = keep safely.

entries.title: entrance
entries.content:
entrance = doorway; which was always an open way for the light, in the absence of windows.

simple = sincere, as opposed to crafty.

entries.title: I longed.
entries.content: I longed. An Aramaic word ( ya'ab) . Occurs only here. Weaker than in verses: Psalms 119:20 , Psalms 119:40 , Psalms 119:174 .

entries.title: merciful
entries.content:
merciful = gracious.

As Thou usest to do = According to Thy ordinance. Hebrew. mishpat. The seventh in order of the "ten words" ( App-73 ). So rendered in Psalms 119:91 .

name. See note on Psalms 20:1 .

entries.title: Order
entries.content:
Order = Direct, or guide.

in = by. Some codices, with one early printed edition, Septuagint, and Vulgate, read "according to".

iniquity. Hebrew ' aven . App-44 .

entries.title: Deliver:
entries.content: Deliver: i.e. by power. Hebrew. padah. See notes on Exodus 6:6 with Exodus 13:13 . Not the same word as verses: Psalms 119:153 , Psalms 119:154 , Psalms 119:170 . man. Hebrew. 'adam. App-14 .

entries.title: Rivers of waters.
entries.content: Rivers of waters. Hebrew. palgey-mayim. See note on Proverbs 21:1 . Eng. idiom = Floods of tears.

entries.title: Righteous, &c.
entries.content: Righteous, &c. See Psalms 119:7 . See also Revelation 16:5 , Revelation 16:7 .

entries.title: righteous and very faithful
entries.content: righteous and very faithful = righteousness and faithfulness.

entries.title: very pure
entries.content: very pure = refined.

entries.title: small = insignificant.
entries.content: small = insignificant. Compare Judges 6:15 .

entries.title: is the truth
entries.content: is the truth = is truth (no Art.) Compare John 17:17 .

entries.title: taken hold.
entries.content: taken hold. Figure of speech Prosopopoeia . App-6 .

entries.title: cried
entries.content:
cried = called [unto Thee], as in Psalms 119:146 .

hear = answer.

entries.title: cried
entries.content: cried = called. Figure of speech Anaphora. App-6 .

entries.title: prevented
entries.content:
prevented = anticipated, or forestalled.

dawning. A Homonym. Hebrew. nephesh. See note on 1 Samuel 30:17 . Authorized Version and Revised Version correctly render it here, and in Job 7:4 ; though not in 1 Samuel 30:17 . Job 24:15 .

word. Same as in Psalms 119:11 ; but some codices, with Septuagint and Vulgate, read "words" (plural)

entries.title: prevent
entries.content:
prevent = anticipate, or forestall.

watches. See App-51 .

entries.title: Hear.
entries.content: Hear. Emphatic = O do hear.

entries.title: after mischief.
entries.content: after mischief. Some codices, with Septuagint, Syriac, and Vulgate, read "after me maliciously".

entries.title: deliver.
entries.content: deliver. Twenty-five Hebrew words so rendered. Here, halaz = rescue (with a gentle hand); not the same word as in verses: Psalms 119:134 , Psalms 119:154 , Psalms 119:170 .

entries.title: deliver.
entries.content: deliver. Hebrew. ga'al = redeem. See notes on Exodus 6:6 with Exodus 13:13 , Not the same word as in verses: Psalms 119:134 , Psalms 119:153 , Psalms 119:170 .

entries.title: tender mercies
entries.content: tender mercies = compassions.

entries.title: enemies
entries.content: enemies = adversaries: i.e. those who hem me in.

entries.title: transgressors.
entries.content:
transgressors. Hebrew. bagad = traitors, or treacherous men.

was grieved = loathed myself: i.e. seeing the same tendencies in myself. Compare Job 42:6 .

entries.title: beginning.
entries.content: beginning. Hebrew. r'osh = head. Put by Figure of speech Synecdoche (of Part), App-6 , for the whole (including the beginning, and "every one", as in next line) = sum and substance, word and words (Jeremiah 15:16 . John 17:8 , John 17:14 ); rendered "sum" in Psalms 139:17 .

entries.title: Princes
entries.content:
Princes = Rulers.

word. Same word as in Psalms 119:9 . Some codices, with Septuagint and Vulgate, read "words" (plural)

entries.title: word.
entries.content: word. Same word as in Psalms 119:11 . Some codices with Septuagint and Vulgate, read "words" (plural)

entries.title: lying
entries.content: lying = falsehood = what is false; especially false religion and idolatry.

entries.title: Seven times.
entries.content: Seven times. Not a "round" number, but the number of spiritual perfection. See App-10 .

entries.title: peace.
entries.content:
peace. Put by Figure of speech Synecdoche (of Part), App-6 , for every blessing connected with peace.

offend them = make them stumble.

entries.title: Deliver
entries.content: Deliver = Rescue. Hebrew. nazal, to pluck out of the hands of an enemy; recover. Not the same word as in verses: Psalms 119:134 , Psalms 119:153 , Psalms 119:154 .

entries.title: utter
entries.content: utter = pour forth or bubble over with. Compare Proverbs 15:2 ; Proverbs 18:4 .

entries.title: speak of.
entries.content: speak of. Hebrew respond with. Put by Figure of speech Synecdoche (of Species), App-6 , for all kinds of speaking or singing; hence = praise.

entries.title: hand.
entries.content: hand. Figure of speech Anthropopatheia ( App-6 ); "hand" put by Figure of speech Metonymy (of Cause), App-6 , for power exercised by it.

entries.title: it shall praise Thee.
entries.content:
it shall praise Thee. Refers to Isaiah 38:20 .

help me. Refers to Isaiah 37:33-36 .

entries.title: lost
entries.content: lost = perishing. Compare Matthew 18:11 ; Luke 19:10 .

entries.title: Title. A Song.
entries.content:
Title. A Song. Hebrew. shir . See App-65 : viz. one of the Songs promised by Hezekiah in Isaiah 38:20 .

degrees = the degrees, or steps. Hebrew. hamma'aloth (with Art.): i.e. the "degrees" mentioned six times in 2 Kings 20:8-11 , and five times in Isaiah 38:8 (Hebrew) No other "degrees" known to Scripture which are connected with the shadow of the sun. For the origin, authorship, examination, and Structure, see App-67 , and note on p. 827.

distress. The first Psalm of each of the five groups speaks of DISTRESS; the second of TRUST; the third of BLESSING AND PEACE IN ZION. The distress, here, refers to Sennacherib ' s siege of Jerusalem (2 Kings 19:3 .Isaiah 37:3; Isaiah 37:3 ).

cried. See 2 Kings 19:3 , 2 Kings 19:4 , 2Ki 19:14-19 . 2 Chronicles 32:20 . Isaiah 37:15-20 ; Isaiah 38:2 , Isaiah 38:3 . See App-67 .

the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 .

heard = answered.

entries.title: Deliver
entries.content:
Deliver = Pluck me. Hebrew. nazal. Same word as in Psalms 119:170 . The reference is to 2 Kings 18:30 , 2 Kings 18:32 .

my soul = me. Hebrew. nephesh. App-13 .

lips. Hebrew = lip: i.e. Rab-shakeh's. The reference is to 2 Kings 18:19-35 ; 2 Kings 19:8-13 . 2 Chronicles 32:10-19 . Isaiah 36:4-20 ; Isaiah 37:8-13 . See App-67 .

tongue. Figure of speech Epistrophe ( App-6 ), with "tongue", Psalms 120:3 .

entries.title: done
entries.content: done = heaped upon: i.e. added to. Compare 1 Samuel 3:17 ; 1 Samuel 20:13 , &c.

entries.title: mighty
entries.content: mighty = Mighty [One].

entries.title: Mesech . . . Kedar.
entries.content: Mesech . . . Kedar. Used typically of cruel and merciless peoples; as we use the terms Vandals, Goths, Philistines.

entries.title: him.
entries.content: him. Some codices, with Septuagint, Syriac, and Vulgate, read "them".

entries.title: I
entries.content:
I = I [even I]; or, I [am all] peace (emphatic).

speak = speak [of peace]. See note on Psalms 109:4 .

they are for war. The reference is to 2 Kings 18:19 . 2 Chronicles 32:2 .Isaiah 36:5 .

entries.title: Title. A Song.
entries.content:
Title. A Song. Hebrew. shir . See App-65 .

of degrees = for, or relating to the degrees. Only here thus. Hebrew. lamma'aloth. See note on Title of 120.

hills = mountains. Add a full stop.

From whence, &c? Punctuate this line as a question. Compare Jeremiah 3:23 .

cometh = is to come.

entries.title: My help.
entries.content:
My help. Figure of speech, Anadiplosis , repeated from end of Psalms 121:1 .

the LORD = Jehovah ( App-4 .), not the hills.

Which made heaven and earth. The reference is to the burden of Hezekiah's prayer (2 Kings 19:15 ; Isaiah 37:16 ). Idols were only the work of men's hands ( 2Ki 19:18 ; 2 Chronicles 32:19 ; Isaiah 37:19 ). Rab-shakeh had reproached "the living God". See further references to this in Psalms 124:8 ; Psalms 134:3 ; and App-67

entries.title: not
entries.content:
not = May He not. Hebrew 'al (like Greek. me) . (Subjective, and conditional).

keepeth . . . (Psalms 121:4 ) keepeth . . . (Psalms 121:5 ) keeper. Note the Figure of speech Polyptoton ( App-6 ). Hebrew. shomreka . . . shomer . . . shomreka. Repeated in verses: Psalms 121:7-8 .

entries.title: neither.
entries.content: neither. Hebrew. l'o (like Greek. ou) . He will not. Absolute.

entries.title: shall preserve thee.
entries.content: shall preserve thee. The repeated promise of Jehovah by Isaiah (2 Kings 19:20-34 .Isaiah 37:6 , Isaiah 37:7 , Isaiah 37:22-25

entries.title: thy going out, &c.
entries.content: thy going out, &c. Idiom for life in general. The promise was fulfilled in 2 Chronicles 32:22 .

entries.title: Title. A Song.
entries.content:
Title. A Song. Hebrew. shir. See note on Title of Psalms 120:1 , and App-65 .

of degrees = of the degrees (with article), as on Title of Psalms 120:1 . See App-67 , and note on p. 827.

of David = by David. A Psalm which Hezekiah found ready to his hand. Some codices, with Aram, and Syriac, omit "of David".

the house of the LORD. Hebrew. the house of Jehovah ( App-4 ). This was Hezekiah's constant care, desire, and thought. It filled his heart. He began his reign by "opening its doors" and cleansing it. See 2 Chronicles 29-31, where it is mentioned seventeen times. He spread Sennacherib's letter before Jehovah there (Isaiah 37:14 ). In his mortal sickness his prayer and its answer related to it (2 Kings 20:5 ). The "sign" he asked related to it (2 Kings 20:8 . Isaiah 38:22 ). His songs were to be sung there (Isaiah 38:20 ). See App-67 .

the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 .

entries.title: shall stand
entries.content:
shall stand = have stood [and shall still stand. ] The reference is to the Passover, which had been kept for "all Israel". See App-67 .

Jerusalem. Note the Figure of speech Anadiplosis ( App-6 ), the word being repeated at the beginning of the next verse.

compact = coupled together (as by a bridge), as Moriah was joined with Zion by the Millo. See note on 1Ki 9:15 ; 2 Kings 12:20 , and App-68 .

entries.title: go up
entries.content:
go up . See App-68 "Zion".

THE LORD . Hebrew Jah. App-4 .

testimony: the Ark of Jehovah.

name. See note on Psalms 20:1 .

entries.title: thrones.
entries.content: thrones. Plural of Majesty = the great Throne.

entries.title: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem.
entries.content: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. Figure of speech Paronomasia ( App-6 ), sha'alu shelom yerushalam yishlayu. See App-67 .

entries.title: Peace be within.
entries.content: Peace be within. Figure of speech Epanadiplosis ( App-6 ), uniting Psalms 122:7 and Psalms 122:8 by beginning and ending with the same words.

entries.title: say
entries.content: say = speak [saying],

entries.title: God.
entries.content: God. Hebrew. Elohim. App-4 .

entries.title: Title. A Song,
entries.content:
Title. A Song, &c. Same as Psalms 120:1 .

dwellest in the heavens. The reference is to 2 Kings 19:16 and Isaiah 37:16 .

entries.title: Behold.
entries.content:
Behold. Figure of speech Asterismos. App-6 .

as. Figure of speech Simile. App-6 .

the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 .

God. Hebrew. Elohim. App-4 .

have mercy = Be gracious. Figure of speech Anaphora . App-6 .

entries.title: contempt
entries.content: contempt = the mockery. Compare Psalms 119:22 , referring to Rab-shakeh.

entries.title: Our soul
entries.content:
Our soul = we. Hebrew. nephesh ( App-13 ).

scorning = the scoffing. The reference is to the scoffing of Sennacherib and Rab-shakeh (2 Kings 18:19-35 ; 2 Kings 19:8-13 . 2 Chronicles 32:10-19 . Isaiah 36:4-21 ; Isaiah 37:8-13 ). App-67 .

at ease. Same Hebrew as "tumult" in 2 Kings 19:28 , and Isaiah 37:29 .

proud = proud oppressors.

entries.title: Title.
entries.content:
Title. See note on Title of Psalms 120 .

the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. See App-4 .

entries.title: men.
entries.content:
men. Hebrew. 'adam. App-14 . (Sing, refers to Sennacherib).

they. The plural, referring to Sennacherib's hosts; likened to a stream and waters in verses: Psalms 124:4 , Psalms 124:5 . See note on Psalms 46:3 .

entries.title: quick
entries.content: quick = alive.

entries.title: stream
entries.content:
stream = torrent, or flood. Hebrew. nahal. See App-67 .

our soul = us. Hebrew. nephesh. App-13 . Note the Figure of speech Epistrophe ( App-6 ) in the repetition at end of Psalms 124:5 .

entries.title: as a bird.
entries.content: as a bird. The reference is to the words of Sennacherib on his cylinder, where he mentions Hezekiah by name, whom he had got "as a bird in a cage". See App-67 .

entries.title: name.
entries.content:
name. See note on Psalms 20:1 .

Who made heaven and earth. See App-67 and note on Psalms 121:2 with Psalms 134:3 .

entries.title: Title.
entries.content:
Title. Same as Psalms 120 . See App-67 .

trust = confide. Hebrew. batah. App-69 .

the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 . Shall be as mount Zion. Some codices, with one early printed edition and Syriac, read "are in Mount Zion". App-68 . for ever. Note the Figure of speech. Epistrophe ( App-6 ), the words being repeated at the end of the next line.

entries.title: For
entries.content:
For = Surely.

rod, or cudgel.

the wicked = the wicked (or lawless) one. Hebrew. rasha, App-44 . Here the reference is to Sennacherib (Isaiah 30:31 ), but it looks forward to 2 Thessalonians 2:3 , 2 Thessalonians 2:4 .

rest upon = continue over,

lot = heritage (as allotted).

righteous. Plural: i.e. Hezekiah and the godly in Israel.

iniquity. Hebrew 'ava l. App-44 .

entries.title: iniquity.
entries.content: iniquity. Hebrew 'ava l. App-44 .

entries.title: the LORD.
entries.content:
the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 .

turned. the captivity = turned the fortunes. This does not refer to a captivity or captives, but to a restoration to blessing. See Job 42:10 and Ezekiel 16:53 and Ezekiel 16:56 , where it is three times explained as "return to your former estate". See App-67 .

Zion. See App-68 .

like them that dream. The reference is to the waking in 2 Kings 19:35 .Isaiah 37:36 . The illustration is in Luke 24:41 .Acts 12:9 (603 B.C.)

entries.title: singing:
entries.content:
singing: i.e. the songs of Isaiah 38:20 .

said they = was it said.

heathen = nations. The reference is to 2 Chronicles 32:22 , 2 Chronicles 32:23 .

The LORD hath done great things. Figure of speech Anadiplosis ( App-6 ), because the phrase is repeated at the beginning of the next verse.

entries.title: streams
entries.content:
streams = torrents. Hebrew. 'aphikim. See 2 Samuel 22:16 . Supply the Ellipsis, "as the streams [are turned] in the Negeb".

in the south = in the Negeb, where, in the hill-country of Judaea the 'aphikim are turned about in their beds between the rocks and in the gorges.

south. Hebrew Negeb; the hill-country of Judaea. See note on Genesis 13:1 , and Deuteronomy 1:7 .

entries.title: sow in tears.
entries.content: sow in tears. The reference is to the "sign" given in Isaiah 37:30 . See App-67 .

entries.title: Title.
entries.content:
Title. A Song of degrees. Same as 120 ("the degrees"). App-67 . The Structure, and the references to Hezekiah being childless ( App-67 . xiv), show that this is not a Psalm "made up of two smaller Psalms, having no connection with each other".

for Solomon = of or by Solomon. The central Psalm of the fifteen. Selected by Hezekiah to complete and perfect the arrangement.

the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 .

the = a.

entries.title: For so
entries.content:
For so = Thus.

beloved = beloved one (singular) Hebrew. yedid. This was Solomon's name (Jedidiah) given by Jehovah (2 Samuel 12:25 ). Solomon was given because David was beloved of Jehovah. Somecodices, with Septuagint, Syriac, and Vulgate, read plural

sleep = in sleep: i.e. while they sleep: i.e. without their labour. So He gave to Solomon (1 Kings 3:5-15 ); to Adam (Genesis 2:21 , Genesis 2:22 ); Abraham (Genesis 15:12 , Genesis 15:13 ); Jacob (Genesis 28:10-15 ); Samuel (1 Samuel 3:3 , 1 Samuel 3:4 ), &c.

entries.title: Lo.
entries.content:
Lo. Figure of speech Asterismos. App-6 .

children = sons. The reference to the fact that Hezekiah was rejoicing in Isaiah's message that he should have a son, made it a suitable Psalm for Hezekiah to select ( 2Ki 20:12 , 2 Kings 20:18 . Isaiah 39:7 ).

of = from. Hence he sings Jehovah ' s praise.

entries.title: Happy is the man.
entries.content:
Happy is the man. Hezekiah was that man. See the Beatitudes. App-63 .

man. Hebrew. geber.

They: i.e. the sons.

not be ashamed. Figure of speech Tapeinosis ( App-6 ): quite the opposite.

speak = meet, whether for negotiation or for fighting.

entries.title: Title. A Song of degrees.
entries.content:
Title. A Song of degrees. Same as 120. See App-67 .

Blessed is = O the happinesses of. See the Beatitudes. App-63 .

feareth = revereth.

entries.title: labour.
entries.content:
labour. Put by Figure of speech Metonymy (of Cause), App-6 , for that which is produced by labour.

thine hands: i.e. thine own hands, in contrast with the opposite (Leviticus 26:16 . Deuteronomy 28:30-33 , Deuteronomy 28:39 , Deuteronomy 28:40 ). See also Amos 5:11 .Micah 6:15 .

entries.title: wife . . . fruitful.
entries.content:
wife . . . fruitful. The reference is, as in Psalms 127 to the fact that Hezekiah was childless at this time and ionged for an heir. App-67 .

children = sons.

entries.title: Behold.
entries.content:
Behold. Figure of speech Asterismos. App-6 .

man = a strong man (plural) Hebrew. geber. App-14 .

blessed. Not the same word as in Psalms 128:1 . That is happy ( Beatitudo ); this is blessed ( Benedictio ).

entries.title: And thou shalt see:
entries.content: And thou shalt see: or, That thou mayest see.

entries.title: thou shalt see.
entries.content:
thou shalt see. Hezekiah did see.

peace. Because this Psalm concludes a group.

entries.title: Title. A Song of degrees.
entries.content: Title. A Song of degrees. Same as 120. See App-67 .

entries.title: Many a time.
entries.content:
Many a time. Figure of speech Anaphora ( App-6 ), being repeated from Psalms 129:1 .

Yet = Nevertheless. Hebrew. gam, as in Psalms 119:24 ("also"); Ezekiel 16:28 . Ecclesiastes 6:7 . Not "reduplicated by mistake, and then spelled differently to make sense", as is alleged by modern criticism.

entries.title: The plowers.
entries.content: The plowers. No Art.

entries.title: The LORD.
entries.content:
The LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah.

righteous = just: i.e. in His judgments.

cords: i.e. of bondage. Compare Psalms 2:3 .

the wicked = lawless ones. Hebrew. rasha'. App-44 .

entries.title: Zion.
entries.content: Zion. See App-68 .

entries.title: as the grass
entries.content:
as the grass = as grass. The reference in verses: Psalms 129:6 , Psalms 129:7 is not to "Egyptian monuments", but to the reply of Jehovah concerning Sennacherib, which Hezekiah quotes here. Compare 2 Kings 19:25 , 2 Kings 19:26 . Isaiah 37:27 .

groweth up. Either unsheatheth itself into flower, or is plucked up (as Septuagint and Vulgate)

entries.title: name.
entries.content: name. See note on Psalms 20:1 .

entries.title: Title. A Song of degrees.
entries.content:
Title. A Song of degrees. Same as 120. See App-67 .

depths. Symbolical of distress. Compare Psalms 42:7 ; Psalms 66:12 ; Psalms 69:2 .

entries.title: LORD *.
entries.content:
LORD *. One of the 134 places where the Sopherim altered Jehovah to Adonai. See App-32 . So also verses: Psalms 130:3 ; Psalms 130:6 .

ears . Figure of speech Anthropopatheia. App-6 .

entries.title: But
entries.content:
But = For; or Because; corresponding with Psalms 130:7 .

forgiveness = the forgiveness: viz. that which Heze-kiah gave thanks for in Isaiah 38:17 .

entries.title: soul.
entries.content:
soul. Hebrew. nephesh . App-13 .

His word: as sent to Hezekiah by Jehovah through Isaiah.

entries.title: watch.
entries.content: watch. Hebrew. shamar = to keep = observe. An astronomical word, as in Psalms 19:11 . Compare Psalms 105:45 ; Psalms 107:43 ; Psalms 119:34 . Omit the italics, note the Figure of speech Epizeuxis. App-6 , and render: "More than watchers for the morning [while] watching for the morning. "

entries.title: mercy
entries.content:
mercy = lovingkindness, or grace.

plenteous redemption. Not only from the king of Assyria (Isaiah 37 ), but from "the king of terrors". redemption. Hebrew. padah. See notes on Exodus 13:13 .

entries.title: redeem.
entries.content:
redeem. Same as Psalms 130:7 .

iniquities. Hebrew. 'avah. App-44 . (Isaiah 38 .)

entries.title: Title. A Song of degrees.
entries.content:
Title. A Song of degrees. Same as Psalms 120 . App-67 .

of David = by David. For its place here see App-67 .

LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 .

high = wonderful.

entries.title: Surely
entries.content:
Surely = [See] whether I have not, &c.

quieted = silenced. Some codices, with Septuagint and Vulgate, read "soothed and uplifted": i.e. comforted.

myself = my soul. Hebrew. nephesh.

My soul = Myself. Hebrew. nephesh . App-13 .

entries.title: Israel.
entries.content: Israel. Not "a liturgical addition", but used to link the three Psalms of this group together (Psalms 129:1 ; Psalms 130:7 , Psalms 130:8 ; Psalms 131:3 ). For Israel is to find rest and peace where their kings (David, and Hezekiah) found it.

entries.title: Title. A Song of degrees.
entries.content:
Title. A Song of degrees. Same as 120. App-67 .

LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 .

remember David = remember for David: i.e. remember to fulfill the promises made to him.

David. Hezekiah remembers David, and puts Jehovah in remembrance of him.

all his afflictions = all his being afflicted: all his anxious cares as to his work. The Temple was Heze-kiah's care, as it had been David's. Not "post-exilic". We see these anxieties from the beginning of his reign (2 Samuel 7:1 , 1 Chronicles 13:3 ; 1Ch 21:18-30 ; 1 Chronicles 22:1 . The subjects of these last three Psalms are merged in blessing.

entries.title: the mighty [God] of Jacob.
entries.content: the mighty [God] of Jacob. The mighty One to Whom Jacob vowed his vow. Title occurs outside the Pentateuch, only here, and Genesis 49:24 ; Isaiah 1:24 (Israel); Psa 49:26 ; Psa 60:16 . Note the Figure of speech Epistrophe ( App-6 ) for emphasis in Psalms 132:5 .

entries.title: I will not come.
entries.content:
I will not come. Note the Figure of speech Periphrases ( App-6 ) in verses: Psalms 132:4 , Psalms 132:5 .

tabernacle = tent. Hebrew. 'ohel. App-40 . Compare Acts 7:46 .

of. Genitive of Apposition = "the Tent: i.e. my house". The emphasis = my own house.

bed = couch.

entries.title: An habitation.
entries.content: An habitation. Plural of Majesty. Hebrew. mishkan ( App-40 .)

entries.title: heard:
entries.content:
heard: i.e. while he was at Ephratah. David"s father was an Ephrathite (of Bethlehem-Ephratah. Compare Genesis 35:19 . David had "heard" of it as being in Shiloh.

it: i.e. the Ark. in the fields of the wood = at Jaar's fields: i.e. Kirjath-jearim (1 Chronicles 13:5 .)

entries.title: tabernacles
entries.content:
tabernacles = the plural of Majesty. His great habitation. Hebrew. Mishkan. App-40 .

footstool. Figure of speech Anthropopatheia. App-6 .

entries.title: Arise.
entries.content:
Arise. Figure of speech Ellipsis ( App-6 ) = [and will say] "Arise, O LORD". &c. This is what Solomon did say in 2 Chronicles 6:41 , see Psalms 68:1 (and note there), according to Numbers 10:35 .Psalms 132:8-10; Psalms 132:8-10 record what David said.

the ark of Thy strength. Occurs only here and 2 Chronicles 6:41 . See notes on Exodus 25:22 and 1 Chronicles 13:3 .

entries.title: saints
entries.content: saints = favoured ones.shout for joy. That is exactly what they did. See the subscription of Psalms 87 and note there on "Mahalath-Leannoth".

entries.title: Thine anointed
entries.content: Thine anointed = i.e. David. Not "Zerubbabel", no such oath made to him.

entries.title: hath sworn.
entries.content:
hath sworn. See 2 Samuel 7:8-17 .

in truth = a truth.

Of the fruit of thy body. This was what Hezekiah was concerned about; for he as yet had no son, and was in danger of death. Hence this pleading of Jehovah's oath to David. Quoted in Acts 2:30 .

entries.title: children
entries.content:
children = sons.

My testimony. Hebrew = "this My testimony". Some codices, with Aramaean, Septuagint, and Vulgate, read "[these] my testimonies" (plural)

children = sons.

entries.title: Zion.
entries.content:
Zion. See App-68 .

His habitation = His dwelling. Figure of speech Anthropopatheia ( App-6 ).

entries.title: her:
entries.content:
her: i.e. Zion's.

poor = needy ones.

entries.title: the horn of David
entries.content:
the horn of David = a horn for David.

to bud: i.e. to bring forth: viz. a son and heir. See App-67 .

lamp. According to Genesis 15:17 ; and note there.

entries.title: his crown:
entries.content: his crown: i.e. his royal crown.

entries.title: Title. A Song of degrees.
entries.content:
Title. A Song of degrees. Same as 120. The three subjects of the three Psalms of this last group are merged in blessing.

of David = by David. Hezekiah found this Psalm exactly suited for his purpose. David wrote it on the experience of a similar blessing of "unity, "when "all Israel" were united "as the heart of ONE MAN "(2 Samuel 19:9 , 2 Samuel 19:14 ). It was the same with Hezekiah. Read 2 Chronicles 30:5 , 2 Chronicles 30:6 , 2Ch 30:11 , 2 Chronicles 30:18 , and note the "ONE HEART" ( Psa 133:12 ). See App-67 .

Behold. The word of the Holy Spirit; as "yea" is of the Father; and "verily" of the Son. Note the Figure of speech Asterismos. App-6 .

how good. This was manifested in 2 Chronicles 30:25 , 2 Chronicles 30:26 .

unity = one. The reference is to the "one man" of 2 Samuel 19:14 (David), and the "one heart" of 2 Chronicles 30:12 (Hezekiah). Hebrew. yahad (not 'ehad. See note on Deuteronomy 6:4 . Compare Josephus ( Antiquities ix. 13, 2).

entries.title: ointment
entries.content:
ointment = oil (Exodus 30:23-25 ).

ran down = descended. Exodus 29:7 . Leviticus 8:12 ; Leviticus 21:10 .

went down = descended, as in Psalms 133:3 .

to the skirts, &c. = to the opening of his robes (see Exodus 28:32 ). Hebrew = mouth (or opening).

entries.title: As
entries.content:
As = [It is] like, as in Psalms 133:2 .

And as the dew. Omit these italics.

descended. Compare Psalms 133:2 .

Zion. The dew (or copious summer night mist) was one. The same dew descended on Zion in the south as on Hermon in the north. Zion's dew represents the tribe of Judah. Hermon's dew represents Asher, Ephraim, Manasseh, Zebulon, Issachar (2 Chronicles 30:11 , 2 Chronicles 30:18 , 2 Chronicles 30:25 , 2 Chronicles 30:26 ). The idea is not in the motion of this dew, from Hermon to Zion, but in its uniting both in its copious descent.

there. Compare Deuteronomy 12:5 , Deuteronomy 12:11 , Deuteronomy 12:14 , Deuteronomy 12:18 , Deuteronomy 12:21 .Psalms 128:5 ; Psalms 134:3 ; Psalms 133 is blessing in Zion; Psalms 132 is blessing for Zion ; Psalms 134 is blessing from Zion.

the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 .

entries.title: Title. A Song of degrees.
entries.content:
Title. A Song of degrees. Same as 120. See App-67 .

Behold. See note on Psalms 133:1 .

the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 .

servants. Limited and denned in next clause, as in Psalms 135:2 .

stand. The night-watchmen. The reference is to 2 Chronicles 29:11 ; 2 Chronicles 30:16 ; 2 Chronicles 31:2 . There were no seats in the Tabernacle or Temple. Compare Hebrews 10:11 .

the house of the LORD. The reference is to Hezekiah's interest in the Temple. See App-67 .

entries.title: heaven and earth.
entries.content:
heaven and earth. The reference is to 2 Chronicles 32:19 . 2 Kings 19:15 .Isaiah 37:16 . See App-67 .

Bless thee. The reference may be to 2Ch 30:27 ; 2 Chronicles 31:10 . This is the last of the fifteen Songs of THE Degrees, which are referred to in Isaiah 38:20 . See App-67 .

out of Zion . See note on "there", Psalms 133:3 .

entries.title: Praise ye THE LORD
entries.content:
This Psalm is probably by Hezekiah, continuing the Songs of the Degrees. Corresponds with 114 and 115. See Structure (p. 826).

Praise ye THE LORD = Hallelujah. App-4 .

name. See note on Psalms 20:1 .

the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. ( App-4 ). Note the three Jehovah's between Jah in Psalms 135:1 and Elohim in Psalms 135:2 . Corresponding with the threefold blessing of Numbers 6:22-27 .

entries.title: the courts.
entries.content: the courts. This includes the People as well as the priests and Levites.

entries.title: it:
entries.content:
it: i.e. His name.

God. Hebrew. Elohim. App-4 .

entries.title: Jacob.
entries.content:
Jacob. Compare Malachi 1:2 .Romans 9:13 . Put also by Figure of speech Metonymy (of Cause) for his posterity ( App-6 ).

Israel. See notes on Genesis 32:28 ; Genesis 43:6 ; Genesis 45:26 , Genesis 45:28 .

peculiar treasure = own possession. See note on Exodus 19:5 .

entries.title: our LORD
entries.content:
our LORD = Adonim. App-4 .

gods. Hebrew. 'elohim. App-4 . Used here of earthly rulers (Psalms 82:6 ), as representing God. See note on Exodus 22:9 , and compare Romans 13:1-7 .

entries.title: heaven, and in earth.
entries.content: heaven, and in earth. Hezekiah's expression. See App-67 .

entries.title: wind.
entries.content:
wind. Hebrew. ruach. App-9 . Compare Psalms 135:7 with Jeremiah 10:13 ; Jeremiah 51:16 .

treasuries. Hebrew = treasures, put by Figure of speech Metonymy (of Adjunct) for treasuries ( App-6 ), and rightly so rendered. Compare Job 38:22 .

entries.title: smote, &c.
entries.content:
smote, &c. Compare Exodus 12:29 .

man. Hebrew. 'adam . App-14 .

entries.title: wonders.
entries.content: wonders. Compare Ex. Psalms 7:14 , and Psalms 136:15 .

entries.title: smote, &c.
entries.content: smote, &c. Compare Numbers 21:26 , Numbers 21:34-35 .

entries.title: Sihon.
entries.content:
Sihon. Compare Numbers 21:21-34 .Deuteronomy 1:4 .

Og. Compare Deuteronomy 31:4 .Joshua 13:31 .

all. Compare Joshua 12:7 .

entries.title: gave their land.
entries.content: gave their land. Compare Joshua 12:7 . An heritage. Repeated by Figure of speech Anadiplosig. App-6 .

entries.title: Thy name.
entries.content: Thy name. Compare Psalms 135:13 with Exodus 3:15 .

entries.title: For, &c.
entries.content:
For, &c. Compare Deuteronomy 32:36 .

judge = vindicate.

repent Himself = have compassion.

entries.title: The idols,
entries.content:
The idols, &c, Psalms 135:15-18 . Not "borrowed" from Psalms 115 , but repeated, and varied, because the object here is quite different. Psalms 115 = heathen theology; Psalm 185 = Divine theology.

heathen = nations.

entries.title: breath.
entries.content: breath. Hebrew. ruach. App-9 .

entries.title: are
entries.content:
are = will become.

trusteth = confideth. Hebrew. batah. App-69 .

entries.title: house of Israel.
entries.content: house of Israel. Includes all Israel. Compare Psalms 115:12 . See note on Exodus 16:31 .

entries.title: Levi.
entries.content: Levi. Not included in 115.

entries.title: out of Zion.
entries.content:
out of Zion. Shows that this Psalm is an expansion of Psalms 134 .

dwelleth. Figure of Speech Anthropopatheia. App-6 .

entries.title: the LORD.
entries.content:
the LORD. Hebrew Jehovah App-4 . For, &c. Figures of Speech. Amoebaeon and Epistrophe. App-6 .

mercy = loving-kindness, or grace.

entries.title: O give thanks.
entries.content:
O give thanks. Note the Figures of speech Coenotes and Anaphora ( App-6 ) in verses: Psalms 136:1 , Psalms 136:2 , Psalms 136:3 .

God of gods. Hebrew. Elohim. of the elohim. App-4 .

gods. Hebrew. 'elohim. See note on Psalms 135:5 and Exodus 22:9 .

entries.title: LORD of lords.
entries.content: LORD of lords. Hebrew Adonim of the adonim. App-4 . Compare Deuteronomy 10:17 .

entries.title: made the heavens.
entries.content: made the heavens. Compare Genesis 1:1 .

entries.title: above.
entries.content: above. i.e. in Genesis 1:1 , and 2 Peter 3:5 . By the overthrow of Genesis 1:2 the earth became a ruin, being "overflowed" (2 Peter 3:6 ), and covered with "the deep" (Genesis 1:2 ).

entries.title: great lights.

entries.title: Babylon.
entries.content: Babylon. The Psalm is anonymous, and probably by Hezekiah. No need to refer it to post-exilic times. The Psalm reads as though it were a reminiscence of past experience in Babylon, and a contrast with previous joys in Zion; not, as during or after the seventy years, or an experience of a then present exile in Babylon. The writer is in Jerusalem after an absence not of long duration; and is full of joy. The post-exilic captives were full of sorrow on their return (Ezra 3:12 .Haggai 2:3; Haggai 2:3 ). These exiles had obeyed Isaiah ' s call (Isaiah 48:20 . Compare Psa 43:14-21 ).

an everlasting kingdom = a kingdom for all ages. Looking backward (eternal, Psalms 77:5 ) as well as forward (everlasting, Psalms 77:7 ). These words, "Thy kingdom [O Christ] is an everlasting kingdom", were (up to 1893) to be seen on the wall of one of the largest Mosques in Damascus. Formerly it was a Temple of Rimmon. It was turned into the (Christian) Church of St. John the Baptist by Arcadius, later it was made into a Mosque by Caliph Walid I (705-717). It was destroyed by fire on Oct 14, 1893, and subsequently rebuilt. ( Enc. Brit vol. 7, p. 785, Camb. (11th) edition.)

fall = are ready to fall.

raiseth up. Occurs only here and Psalms 146:8 .

entries.title: eyes of all wait.
entries.content: eyes of all wait. Figure of speech Prosopopoeia. App-6 .

entries.title: Thou.
entries.content:
Thou. This is emphatic in Sept, Syriac, and Vulgate. Compare Psalms 104:26 .

hand. Figure of speech Anthropopatheia. App-6 .

entries.title: holy
entries.content: holy = gracious.

entries.title: nigh:
entries.content:
nigh: i.e. nigh to help. Compare Psalms 34:18 ; Psalms 119:151 .Deuteronomy 4:7 .

unto all. Note the Figure of speech Anadiplosis ( App-6 ) in the repetition, "to all that call" (for emphasis).

entries.title: their cry:
entries.content: their cry: i.e. for help in distress.

entries.title: wicked
entries.content: wicked = lawless. Hebrew. rasha. App-44 .

entries.title: let all flesh
entries.content:
let all flesh = all flesh shall, as in Psalms 145:10 ; thus completing and perfecting the Structure above.

all flesh. Figure of speech Synecdoche (of the Part), App-6 , put for all men.

holy. See note on Exodus 3:5 .

ever and ever. Many codices, with one early printed edition, here add: "And we will bless Jah: From henceforth even for ever, Praise ye Jah. "Compare Psalms 115:18 .

entries.title: Praise ye THE LORD
entries.content:
The first of the five "Hallelujah" Psalms concluding the whole book; each beginning and ending with this word. The first has GENESIS for its subject; the second, Exodus; the third, LEVITICUS; the fourth, NUMBERS, and the fifth, DEUTERONOMY. See the Structure, p. 827, and notes below.

Praise ye THE LORD = Hallelu-JAH. App-4 .

Praise. Figure of speech Apostrophe. App-6 .

the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 .

O my soul = O I myself (emphatic). Hebrew. nephesh. App-13 .

entries.title: God.
entries.content: God. Hebrew. Elohim. App-4 .

entries.title: trust
entries.content:
trust = confidence. Hebrew. batah. App-69 .

man. Hebrew. 'adam. App-14 .

no help = no salvation, or saving help. Compare Psalms 33:16 ; Psalms 60:11 .

entries.title: His breath, &c.
entries.content:
His breath, &c. This verse occurs in the Apocrypha (1 Mace. Psa 2:63 ); but why is it assumed that this verse is taken from the Book of Maccabees, instead of this verse in Maccabees being taken from this Psalm?

breath = spirit. Hebrew. ruach. App-9 . Not the same word as in Psalms 150:6 .

returneth. See Genesis 2:7 ; Genesis 3:19 , and compare Ecclesiastes 12:7 . Ecc 104:29 .

earth = ground, or dust. Hebrew. 'adamah. Not ' erez = the Earth.

thoughts = purposes, or plans.

entries.title: Happy.
entries.content:
Happy. The last of the twenty-seven Beatitudes in the Book of Psalms. See App-63 .

GOD. Hebrew El. App-4 .

of Jacob: i.e. the God who met Jacob (Genesis 28:13 ) when he had nothing (Genesis 32:10 and deserved nothing (but wrath, Genesis 27 ) and promised him everything. This title answers to the N.T. title "the Godof all grace" (1 Peter 5:10 ). Happy indeed are all they who have this God for their God.

Whose. Supply the Ellipsis by repeating [Happy he] whose, &c.

hope = expectation.

entries.title: made heaven, and earth.
entries.content: made heaven, and earth. Another reference to Genesis 1 . Compare Psalms 146:4 . See notes on Genesis 14:19 and Deuteronomy 4:26 .

entries.title: food.
entries.content:
food. Hebrew bread. Put by Figure of speech Synecdoche (of Species), App-6 , for food in general.

the. No Art. in Hebrew

entries.title: strangers
entries.content:
strangers = aliens.

relieveth. Plenty of saving "help" here. Compare the contrast with "man", (Psalms 146:3 ), "no help".

wicked = lawless. Hebrew. rasha'.

entries.title: for ever.
entries.content:
for ever. Contrast Psalms 146:4 . Compare Revelation 11:15 .

Zion. See App-68 .

entries.title: Praise ye THE LORD.
entries.content:
The second of these five Hallelujah Psalms, the EXODUS Psalm.

Praise ye THE LORD. Hebrew Hallelu-JAH. App-4 . Not "inserted by mistake in verse Psalms 147:1 instead of in the title", but required here by the Structure. See the Structure.

For. Not "come into the first line from the second by dittography", but an essential part of the second line, which is repeated by the Figure of speech Anadiplosis ( App-6 ) in the third line. The first verse thus does contain two lines (beside the "Hallelujah") like all the other verses.

God. Hebrew. Elohim. App-4 .

entries.title: The LORD.
entries.content:
The LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 .

doth build up Jerusalem = is Jerusalem's builder (participle). No reference to post-exilic building. Compare Psalms 122:3 .

gathereth = will gather.

outcasts = the driven away.

entries.title: stars . . . names.
entries.content:
stars . . . names. See App-12 . Compare Isaiah 40:26 .

names. The reference is to the knowledge of the "names" in building up the nation of Israel. Compare verses: Psalms 147:2 ; Psalms 147:20 with Exodus 1:7-20 ; and verses: Psa 15:19 with Exodus 20 .

entries.title: our LORD.
entries.content:
our LORD. Hebrew. 'Adonim. App-4 . Compare Psalms 135:5 .

of great power = abounding in power. Compare Isaiah 40:26 .

entries.title: the meek
entries.content:
the meek = meek or humble ones. Numbers 12:3 .

wicked = lawless. Hebrew. rasha. App-44 .

entries.title: mountains.
entries.content: mountains. The Septuagint adds "and herb for the service of men". From thence it found its way into the Prayer Book Version. Compare Psalms 104:14 . Here, the addition is out of place, as "man" is not introduced till Psalms 147:10 .

entries.title: He taketh not.
entries.content:
He taketh not. Some codices, with Septuagint, Syriac, and Vulgate, read "Nor taketh delight".

man. Hebrew ' ish . App-4 .

entries.title: hope in His mercy
entries.content: hope in His mercy = wait for His lovingkindness.

entries.title: Praise the LORD.
entries.content: Praise the LORD. Not the same word as in Psalms 147:1 . Used only by David and Solomon. Zion. See App-68 . Zion then still standing.

entries.title: children
entries.content: children = sons.

entries.title: peace in thy borders
entries.content: peace in thy borders = thy borders peace.

entries.title: commandment
entries.content: commandment = sayings, or utterances. Hebrew. 'imrah. See App-73 . Compare Psalms 33:9 ; Psalms 107:20 .

entries.title: word.
entries.content:
word. Hebrew. dabar = the subject-matter of the articulate utterance (Psalms 147:16 ). See App-73 .

wind. Hebrew. ruach, App-9 .

entries.title: word.
entries.content:
word. Some codices, with Septuagint, Syriac, and Vulgate, read "word". Others read plural.

Jacob . . . Israel. See notes on Genesis 32:28 ; Compare Psa 43:6 ; Psa 45:26 , Psa 45:28 .

entries.title: not dealt so, &c.
entries.content:
not dealt so, &c. The reference is to Exodus 20 . Compare Deuteronomy 4:7 , Deuteronomy 4:8 ; and see App-15 .

they have not known them. Septuagint and Vulg, read "He maketh not known to them".

entries.title: Praise ye THE LORD.
entries.content:
The third of the last five Hallelujah Psalms. The LEVITICUS Psalm. Compare Psalms 148:14 with Leviticus 10:3 .

Praise ye THE LORD. Hallelu-JAH. App-4 .

the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. with 'eth = Jehovah Himself. App-4 .

heights. As in Job 16:19 ; Job 25:2 .

entries.title: stars of light.
entries.content: stars of light. Genitive of Origin ( App-17 .) = stars that give light = lightbearers, as in Genesis 1:14-16 .

entries.title: which shall not pass:
entries.content: which shall not pass: or, which [they] shall not pass.

entries.title: the earth.
entries.content:
the earth. Note the change and see Structure above.

dragons = sea monsters.

entries.title: wind.
entries.content: wind. Hebrew. ruach . App-9 .

entries.title: people
entries.content: people = peoples.

entries.title: name.
entries.content:
name. See note on Psalms 20:1 .

earth and heaven: i.e. combining the two subjects of Psalms 148:1 and Psalms 148:7 . This order of these two words occurs only here and Genesis 2:4 . Compare note on Deuteronomy 4:26 .

entries.title: saints
entries.content:
saints = favoured ones, or beloved.

children = sons.

near unto Him. The reference is to Leviticus and its leading thought. See Leviticus 10:3 ; Leviticus 21:21 ; and Compare Psalms 65:4 .

entries.title: Praise ye THE LORD.
entries.content:
The fourth of the concluding five Hallelujah Psalms, answering to NUMBERS. Compare verses: Psalms 149:5-9 with Numbers 24:17-24 .

Praise ye THE LORD. Hebrew Hallelu-JAH. App-4 .

the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 .

congregation = assembly (in its military aspect).

saints = favoured ones, or beloved, Psalms 149:5 .

entries.title: Israel.
entries.content:
Israel. Compare the Structure.

children = sons.

Zion. See App-68 .

entries.title: name.
entries.content:
In the Hebrew this verse is an Introversion : them praise His name. the dance. the drum and harp. them sing praises unto Him.

name. See note on Psalms 20:1 .

timbrel = drum. See note on Exodus 15:20 .

entries.title: taketh pleasure.
entries.content: taketh pleasure. Compare Isaiah 54:7 , Isaiah 54:8 .

entries.title: in glory
entries.content:
in glory = "with [ascriptions of] glory".

beds = couches.

entries.title: high praises
entries.content:
high praises = extollings.

GOD. Hebrew El. App-4 .

entries.title: heathen
entries.content:
heathen = nations.

people = peoples.

entries.title: the judgment written.
entries.content: the judgment written. See Deuteronomy 32:40-43 . Compare Isaiah 45:14 .Ezekiel 25:14 ; Ezekiel 3 8 and Ezekiel 39 . Zechariah 14 . The special reference is to Numbers 24:17-24 .

entries.title: Praise ye THE LORD.
entries.content:
The fifth of the last five Hallelujah Psalms, answering to the great thought of DEUTERONOMY. Compare Psalms 150:2 with Deuteronomy 3:24 , and Deuteronomy 32:43 .

Praise ye THE LORD. Hebrew Hallelu-JAH. App-4 .

GOD. Hebrew El. App-4 .

sanctuary. The earthly sanctuary and the heavenly: the lower being formed on the pattern of the higher. See Hebrews 8:5 ; Hebrews 9:23 ; and compare 1 Chronicles 28:13 , 1 Chronicles 28:19 .

firmament: Hebrew = expanse (Genesis 1:6 ).

entries.title: for
entries.content:
for = in [the recital of] His mighty acts.

mighty acts. Some codices, with Aram, and Syriac, read "His might".

excellent = the abundance of His greatness or grandeur.

entries.title: the.
entries.content: the. No Art. in Hebrew text.

entries.title: timbrel
entries.content:
timbrel = drum. See note on Exodus 15:20 .

organs = pipe, or reed (singular, never pl).

entries.title: breath.
entries.content:
breath. Hebrew. neshamah (see App-16 ): i.e. in contrast with material instruments.

praise THE LORD. Hebrew. tehallel jah.

Praise ye THE LORD. Hebrew. Halelujah, thus fitly closing the Book of Psalms. Compare the endings of the other four books; and see notes on p. 720.
